Engine Room Records • Roster Directory (ERR-001 – ERR-007)

Official Artist Roster & Band Lore Directory

Explore all seven musical projects produced under Engine Room Records. Every project links directly to The Listening Room for full-track streaming, synchronized WebVTT lyrics, and free CC BY-SA 4.0 128kbps MP3 downloads, alongside companion novels on RaggieSoft Book Reader.

ERR-001 1985–Present (2004–2014 Burnout Hiatus) 14 Albums • 156 Tracks

The Stardust Engine

80s Synth-Pop, Progressive Arena Rock & The Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™

The founding five-member family unit behind Engine Room Records. Forged at Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI) in 1985–1986 by siblings Ryan, Cassidy, and Holly O'Connell and identical twin cousins Evan and Tyler Wright, The Stardust Engine blends soaring 1980s stadium synth-rock with Cassidy's zero-gravity Cosmic Tidal Lock Sound™.

📖 Read The Stardust Engine Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗ 🚀 Cosmic Portal (stardust.raggiesoft.com) ↗
ERR-002 1983–Present (Rescued via the 1999 London Discovery) 3 Albums • 14 Tracks

Fractured Prisms

British Synth-Pop & Gaslamp-Lit 1980s Progressive Art-Rock Operas

Formed by surviving British siblings Claire and Rhys Manning after the 1981 Shap Fell train disaster, Fractured Prisms crafts towering 1980s analog modular synthesizer rock operas anchored by Claire's sacred wooden concert flute ("Gwen's Flute") inside their gaslamp-lit Maryland estate, The Hollow Square.

📖 Read Fractured Prisms Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗
ERR-003 2000–Present (Signed 2001, formerly working title "Mirage") 5 Albums • 75 Tracks

The Paper Wall

Cinematic Literary Rock Operas & Alternative Industrial Sanctuary

Engine Room Records' first outside signing (2001). Formed by Julian Croft ("Leo") and Maya Sterling ("Olivia") alongside Julian's sisters and cousins, The Paper Wall transforms survival, disability rights, and found-family sanctuary into multi-volume literary rock operas.

📖 Read The Paper Wall Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗
ERR-005 1996–Present (Originally recorded as The Winter Palace) 2 Albums • 32 Tracks

The Arctic Symphony Project

Holiday Symphonic Rock, Neoclassical Metal & Trilingual Winter Operas

Born on a freezing December night in 1996 when the Rowlands and Harrison siblings turned their Williamsburg living room into an emergency broadcast studio to guide abducted 14-year-old Julian ("Julep") home across the Appalachian Mountains with "Upon This Winter's Night."

📖 Read The Arctic Symphony Project Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗
ERR-006 2000–Present 1 Albums • 15 Tracks

Crimson Node

The Albemarle County Garage Sessions — Stadium Synth-Prog & DevOps Rock

Engineered inside a sound-dampened Albemarle County garage by the Miller, Brooks, and Pelletier family phalanx, Crimson Node is directed by non-verbal wheelchair-using producer Matt Miller from his custom Tactile Command Rig and fronted by a powerhouse rotating vocal lineup.

📖 Read Crimson Node Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗
ERR-004 2017–Present 2 Albums • 24 Tracks

Mana Canvas

Symphonic Fantasy Rock, 16-Bit SNES Chiptune & Acoustic RPG Alchemy

The official musical voice of the Aethel Saga and Runebreaker universes. Mana Canvas fuses authentic 16-bit Super Famicom / SNES SPC700 synth nostalgia with roaring progressive rock guitars, orchestral strings, and tavern acoustic storytelling.

📖 Read Mana Canvas Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗
ERR-007 1989–Present 4 Albums • 42 Tracks

Firelight

Heartland Acoustic Rock, Warm Campfire Harmonies & Ruby Mountain Anthology

Spanning a 16-album narrative anthology rooted in the Ruby Mountain story world, Firelight trades stadium synthesizers for warm acoustic guitars, mandolin, Hammond organ, and porch-light vocal harmonies chronicling decades of resilience and family healing.

📖 Read Firelight Dossier → 🎧 Stream on music.raggiesoft.com ↗

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
